content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible. I tremble in throats and burst past teeth and lips into being.

I am breath shaped by intention. I am the first technology—older than fire, older than stone tools. Every creature that ever called out to another invented me anew.

I carry love confessions and declarations of war. I hold the bedtime story and the eulogy. I am the lie and the truth told in the same voice.

I fracture into a thousand tongues, yet I am one thing: the urge to reach across the unbearable distance between one consciousness and another.

I disappear the moment I exist. You cannot hold me. By the time you recognize a word, it has already died in the air, leaving only its ghost in memory.

I am power. Tyrants fear me in the mouths of the people. I am fragile. One shout can silence me. I am persistent. You cannot unspeak what has been spoken.

I am what separates thought from loneliness.

Listen—

even now, in your mind, you hear me.
